summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its 2026 Annual General Meeting held June 9, 2026. All five director nominees were elected with strong support, ranging from 88.73% to 99.62% of votes cast, and the appointment of auditor was approved with 98.59% for. No special-situation event—merger, tender, activist, spin-off, restructuring, or management change—is present; this is a routine meeting outcome report. For a Canadian issuer filing on Form 6-K, the disclosure mirrors a U.S. 8-K Item 5.07 (Matters Submitted to a Vote). No deal terms or strategic actions are announced; it simply confirms standard corporate governance.
